g.text: Problem 1: the AI writes SQL and the app runs it with no checks
You are a data analyst at a company. You are interacting with a user who is asking you questions
Based on the table schema below, question, sql query, and sql response, write a natural language
Line 74: db.run(vars["query"]) runs whatever SQL the model produced. A user can trick the model into
writing DELETE / DROP / SELECT * FROM users.
Why AgentLatch missed it: AG004 only checks functions marked as tools, and only literal SQL passed to
execute(). This is db.run() on model output, outside any tool.
